mostWorthwhile.text: Following insulin to muscle was most worthwhile: it connected the pancreas's message to glucose leaving the blood, then showed insulin release decreasing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Starting with the heat-conserving body was a little confusing; I didn't know why that state was needed for an after-meal glucose response.

surprise.text: The pancreas sent a different message between meals, and that message faded after the liver released glucose.

arbitrary.text: Using the heat-conserving body as the starting piece felt arbitrary for this fuel lesson, even though it carried the body over from the previous chapter.

continue.text: I would probably continue: comparing the two responses made the body's changing fuel supply understandable, and I'd be curious to see another connection.
